verification_methods: exact lexicographic Groebner ideals on three affine charts
independent evaluation at all points over the extensions F_(2^r), 1 <= r <= 10, justified by normalization genus formula

scientific_limitations: Exact claims concern pencils whose three F2-rational members are geometrically smooth, not all algebraic-closure-indexed members.
Only plane quintics over F2 through the seven points of P2(F2) are classified.
All projective equivalence and stabilizers are over F2, not over its algebraic closure.
Historical priority may be affected by unindexed exact finite-field curve and pencil censuses.
title: Pencils of smooth plane-filling quintics over the binary projective plane
